verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an inference cloud, and an in-console feature that produces AI insights or suggestions about a user's data (for example usage or cost recommendations) is plausible for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows API building blocks: OpenAI-compatible chat completions, embeddings and RAG models, and vision/OCR. A developer could use these to build such a feature, but that earns no credit. Nothing documents a built-in insights or suggestions capability inside the product.
